_fixture.provenance: Trimmed from a REAL capture on an UNLISTED video. This is the counter-example to get_captions_timings_ack.json: the same endpoint, carrying a full timed track.
_fixture.why_it_matters: The endpoint is an aligner. When the request carries transcript.text it returns timings; when Studio is only creating a draft it returns just responseContext. Neither response proves anything about the other, which is why every plausible source is parsed rather than one being declared correct.
_fixture.redaction: serviceTrackingParams dropped (it carried the real channel id). The request half is not stored: it carried eats, sessionInfo.token, clientScreenNonce, onBehalfOfUser and the full transcript text.
_fixture.note: Unlike get_captions_translation, there is NO languageCode or displayName here, so the language must come from the request.
